name: Splatch
definition: A lightweight, fast, public ray-tracing software tool designed for visualizing point-like data from cosmological simulations (e.g., SPH), optimizing ray-tracing by ordering particles by depth and calculating emission/absorption composition.
summary: Splatch is a lightweight, CPU-based ray-tracing tool that renders cosmological particle data into realistic 3D images using analytical integration and depth-based ordering.
